name: Benditz
personality: Old, bookish mentor type still chasing his dream of becoming a general.
story: Benditz is a one-eyed elderly knight who once captained a hundred-man temple unit until a scandal cost him the post. He now works as a mercenary and still wants to become a general, and he enjoys mentoring the young. He appears in Dagsion around 11/4 on all routes.

personalSkill.effect: If unit is a charioteer, grants Hit+20. Lv 20: Chariot Stagger (+1 use of staggering blows as a charioteer); Lv 35: Chariot Stagger+ (+2 uses).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: C tier (late arrival 4/11; ability locked to chariot classes). Pocket Tactics: C tier.

guide.role: Filler; optional Part II chariot archer and wall
guide.summary: A filler on Theodora's route: recruit him in Ch 10 or later (Renown 8) as a Part III body. If a Part II slot opens, he's a [[class:Charioteer]] wall: Wheeled Warrior's Hit +20 lands [[item:Longbow]] [[art:Deadeye]], and Charge with extra staggering blows breaks lines.
guide.playstyle: Charge into lines, then sit in front of the archers with the shield up: Chariot Armor can't dodge, so he lives on Def. [[art:Deadeye]] from range 3 to 5 on shields and bosses.
keys: In Dagsion from 4/11; recruit once Renown 8 lands (Ch 10+).
Bench him all of Part I: no Arena seat, and his barters come after the main army's.
Equip the [[item:Longbow]] and [[item:Da Mina Shield]] before Ch 12 ends if he may play Part II.
Take [[class:Charioteer]] on Part II Ch 1's free License and hold it for every floor.
Dip into [[class:Sniper]] in Part II Ch 5 for [[ability:Marksmanship]], then back to the chariot.
watch: Role: filler. Part II's 15 slots go to the main nine and six bench units; he plays if one drops.
Res: 25 growth. Mages delete him; keep Sofia ([[ability:Barrier]]) beside him on mage maps.
Chariot only: Wheeled Warrior and [[ability:Chariot Stagger]] switch off in [[class:Sniper]], so the dip stays short.
Weight: [[item:Longbow]] 13 + [[item:Da Mina Shield]] 5 = 18, no doubles; fine for a wall. [[item:Da Mina Bow]] 6 + 5 = 11 for follow-ups.
